messages:
harper: Postmortem follow-up: new regression pattern observed where transient DNS timeouts cause immediate LB host-rotation, which then collides with cert rotation and produces TLS handshake failures. Need owners, small scoped actions, and timelines.
leo: Seen this in traces at 09:22 UTC. Lots of clients hit fallback region for ~2s windows. The spike correlates with rapid re-resolves and then host-blacklist events.
mira: logs:
```
2026-08-19T09:22:11Z dns.client: query=svc.internal response=TIMEOUT
2026-08-19T09:22:11Z lb.edge: resolve_retry host=svc.internal attempt=1
2026-08-19T09:22:11Z lb.edge: host_blacklist_add host=10.5.9.17 duration=2s reason=resolve_fail
2026-08-19T09:22:11Z tls.cache: handshake_failed host=10.5.9.17 sni=svc.internal err=SNI_MISMATCH
```
sam: Quick proposal of focused items we can execute this week: 1) soft-fail resolver results for 3s before escalating to blacklist, 2) add a short hold after cert rotate to avoid SNI mismatch during immediate fallbacks, 3) surface a combined alert for rapid resolves + rotations.
harper: Concrete owners/targets:
- R1: Soft-fail window: treat single resolve timeout as "probation" for 3s; only escalate on repeat within that window. Owner: leo. ETA: PR in 48h, canary in 4 days.
- R2: Cert-rotate hold: after cert reload, block fallback-based routing to rotated hosts for 5s to let certs propagate. Owner: mira. ETA: config change in 3 days.
- R3: Metrics+Alert: combined metric (resolve_rate_per_host + rotation_count) and a 5m alert for spikes. Owner: harper. ETA: dashboard + alert in 2 days.
leo: I'll take R1. Implementation note: in-process resolver wrapper in lb-agent; do not change system resolver. Add unit tests to simulate timeout->success within probation window.
mira: I'll prototype R2 as a small flag in the rotation logic; keep default disabled until canary. Will add runbook note.
harper: infra-bot: create ticket for this set of follow-ups
infra-bot: Created INC-4921: https://tracker.internal/INC-4921 - "edge: resolver-timeout -> rotation -> tls-regression follow-ups" assigned to triage
sam: small follow-up: add an e2e chaos test that simulates resolver timeouts + cert rotate to validate we don't flip for <10s. Owner: sam. ETA: 1 week.
leo: starting R1 branch now, will post PR link to INC-4921 when ready.
mira: R2 in staging as a feature-flagged change; will run soak and report.
harper: Please update INC-4921 with PRs, dashboards, and test results. I'll run a status sync next Wed. If anything slips, tag eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
